title: Flap change dynamics (Extension)
objective: Demonstrate simulator response to extending flaps from Index 0 to Index 1.
demonstration: Extend flaps from Index 0 to Index 1 and allow free response. Record at least 5 seconds before motion and 15 seconds after motion ends.
tolerance_catalog: +/- 1.5 deg or +/- 20% pitch angle | +/- 3 kt airspeed | +/- 30 m (100 ft) altitude
runtime_configuration: Existing Flap Change Dynamics Manual and Recorded Replay workflow
